scientific_integrity: An analytic proof gives the infinite statement; finite exact-rational checks only corroborate selected cases. The nonfreezing boundary case was already published and is credited.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified seven-agent system and closed two-dimensional parameter square are classified; no full seven-dimensional genericity claim. Equivalent published results outside the inspected primary literature remain possible; independent validation has not been conducted.
title: Exact logarithmic switching lifetime near a nonfreezing seven-agent confidence system
